title: Manufacturing Differential Sparsity: Planner-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient World Model Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: JEPA-style latent world models let embodied agents plan toward new goals with model predictive control, but they are still too slow for real-life embodied control: sampling-based MPC repeats predictor inference tens of thousands of times per plan, and even on high-end GPUs one planning step can take tens of seconds. We observe substantial latent locality in this repeated-inference workload: the predictor maps close actions to close latents, and inside a quantized predictor this closeness takes a form that hardware can exploit, differential bit-level sparsity. Unlike an input stream, whose temporal similarity is given, a planner itself decides which candidates it evaluates together, so the planner can choose its own references and, with reference forest sampling, manufacture more sparsity: it couples the sampled action sequences of each group to a shared root, with competitive planning quality. translated_title: 制造差分稀疏性：面向高效世界模型规划的规划器-硬件协同设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.22483v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：JEPA风格的潜在世界模型使具身智能体能够通过模型预测控制（MPC）向新目标进行规划，但对于现实生活中的具身控制而言它们仍然太慢：基于采样的MPC在每次规划中需要重复执行数万次预测器推理，即使在高端GPU上，单个规划步骤也可能耗时数十秒。我们观察到这种重复推理工作负载中存在显著的潜在局部性：预测器将相近的动作映射到相近的潜在表示，而在量化预测器内部，这种相近性呈现出一种硬件可利用的形式——差分位级稀疏性。与输入流（其时间相似性是给定的）不同，规划器自身决定将哪些候选一起评估，因此规划器可以选择自己的参考，并通过参考森林采样制造更多稀疏性：它将每组采样动作序列耦合到共享根节点上，同时保持有竞争力的规划质量。我们基于这些洞察构建了加速器……
tldr: 该论文发现量化世界模型预测器中相近动作会产生差分位级稀疏性，并提出规划器-硬件协同设计，通过参考森林采样主动“制造”稀疏性，从而大幅加速具身智能体的MPC规划。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a planner-hardware co-design that exploits and actively "manufactures" differential bit-level sparsity via reference forest sampling, dramatically accelerating sampling-based MPC planning for JEPA-style world models in embodied agents.
